• Save favourites for later
• Add selected products to your wardrobe

record.name: ONMODEL: AI Fashion Lookbook
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn garment photos into a polished on-model fashion lookbook.

ONMODEL is an AI fashion studio for independent labels, fashion designers, stylists, and e-commerce teams. Create consistent product imagery without booking a studio, organizing a casting, or writing complicated prompts.

HOW IT WORKS

1. ADD YOUR GARMENT
Start with a front photo of your garment. Optionally add back and close-up photos of the same item to guide generation and garment checks. ONMODEL analyzes category, fit, color, fabric, and the details that should stay protected.

2. CAST YOUR MODEL
Choose from diverse synthetic models or use a brand-owned face. Set the body direction and use Face Lock when consistency matters.

3. DIRECT THE SCENE
Pick studio, lookbook, editorial, campaign, or location-based scenes. Control pose, styling, fabric, footwear, and items that must not be added.

4. PREVIEW BEFORE FINALIZING
Generate flexible preview batches, compare front, back and detail references in Garment Truth, zoom in, and choose only the strongest shots before creating final-quality exports.

5. FINISH EVERY SHOT
Use Precision Repair to select an exact area and correct garment shape, fabric, print, faces, hands, or backgrounds. Styling Swap changes jeans, trousers, skirts, tops, outer layers, or footwear while keeping your uploaded product locked. Verified Repairs retry unchanged results and return credits when a repair fails.

CREATE MORE FROM EACH LOOK

- Generate 5-second Motion Looks with subtle walks, fabric movement, or editorial camera push-ins
- Export PNG/JPG image sets and Instagram-ready crops
- Build PDF lookbooks; members can add their own brand name
- Work on iPhone or in a native iPad layout with larger previews and spacious multi-column browsing
- Keep credit balances synced securely through server-side verification

ONMODEL is built for real fashion workflows: clear product presentation, controlled styling, premium visual direction, and faster creative decisions.
